Yappa 0.1.0-dev Windows friend-test build

Keep every file in this folder together and run yappa.exe.
This development build is not code-signed yet, so Windows may show an Unknown
Publisher warning. Do not bypass any certificate warning inside Yappa itself.

Test:
1. Join using only the server's public IP.
2. Confirm messages and online presence update without reconnect banners.
3. Confirm website cards appear, including a YouTube player card.
4. Join and leave voice twice; report any encryption or connection error.
5. Restart Yappa and confirm the saved session returns.

Send screenshots and the exact visible error text for any failure.
Never send passwords, session tokens, private keys, or server .env files.
